scope: Reversible isolated compatible-client diagnostic from the surviving S6 Recruit checkpoint toward Specialist class gear and Alia Das Power Cell purchase
result: The client reached Kincaid, trained Specialist, and accepted mission 2011. The copied database saved class 3, level 5 and mission 2011 active. Ordinary movement toward Caufield reached the barracks tent wall at (765.324,293.895,392.242) and did not reach his mission interaction. A nearby marked NPC did not open conversation from that position. The run therefore did not acquire Repair-O-Matic, inspect the vendor, buy template 56, reload, or use the tool. No final-live stock or price claim follows from this diagnostic.

source_and_staging.lost_checkpoint_note: The prior staged Specialist checkpoint disappeared with the old /home/blizz/backups tree; it was absent when checked on 2026-09-24. No Specialist checkpoint was found under /home/blizz/private-artifacts or the replacement backups tree at that time.

transport_attempts.result: Manual login reached server selection. Auth logged AboutToPlay and queue redirect, but the client remained on Sending server request; Game logged no client. Stopped and restored.
Direct /server and /character startup reproduced the redirect stall. Stopped and restored.
Direct startup again did not reach Game. Stopped and restored.

successful_run.accepted_movement: output/positions.tsv; after class choice, from (768.0,294.148,386.047) via (766.402,293.934,388.246) and (765.395,293.895,391.207) to (765.324,293.895,392.242). Final route controller reported no further accepted progress toward Caufield (760,407).

limits: The source character was edited to the tier gate; this run does not verify earned S5/S6 XP or normal progression to class choice.

The first three queue stalls only establish behavior of the shifted-port diagnostic harness, not a retail protocol restriction. The copied harness's default numeric ports worked inside its private namespace.

Caufield's objective, class gear reward, vendor stock and price, purchase, reload and repair use remain untested in this continuation. Earlier isolated class-gear results are documented separately in docs/evidence/client-specialist-class-gear.json.
This verifies current emulator behavior with a compatible client; it does not establish final-live server behavior.
